text:
tash: PledgeBank legal says compliance proofpack is final gating item for the Dedicated POC. They specifically want: SOC2 control mapping (no full report), ISO 27001 certificate page (they asked for cert number), signed pen-test authorization letter, short KMS custody statement for the POC, and confirmation on whether SAML assertions will be redacted in shared logs. Need before kickoff Mon next week.

evan: small correction - they want the ISO cert number and the scope page that lists 'cloud inference services' explicitly. I can pull cert excerpt.

marie: I'll own SOC2 control mapping and will mark which artifacts are shareable vs need redaction/DPA. ETA: EOD tomorrow. I'll include a table: control -> our evidence path (policy excerpt, config screenshots, presigned s3 sample).

raj: For KMS custody: two choices: (1) Redwood-managed keys (we retain keys, AES-256, keys never exported) or (2) customer BYOK via HSM in their cloud account for Private. For a short Dedicated POC we can provide a custody statement that confirms option (1) and documents upgrade path to BYOK. Drafting now.

ben: Pen-test letter: Legal needs vendor name + test window + target IPs/CIDR. I can draft an authorization template to speed sign-off. Minimal language below: ```
Redwood Inference hereby authorizes [vendor name] to perform coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against the following targets: [list IPs/CIDRs]. Testing window: [start] - [end]. Tests must be scheduled with Redwood SRE at least 72 hours in advance, be non-destructive, and not exfiltrate customer data. Findings classified as critical must be reported immediately to Redwood Security.```

legal-bot: NOTE: Legal review required. Typical turnaround for minimal pen-letter is 48 business hours once vendor and CIDR are provided. Please attach vendor contact and proposed dates to ticket LEG-8812.

infra-bot: INFO: Ticket NET-2045 created for VPC diagram + CIDR assignment. Diagram ETA 36 hrs after Dedicated confirmation.

marie: Customer follow-up: "Do not send raw SAML assertions. Provide access-control policy excerpt and a sanitized log sample with SAML subject IDs hashed." I'll mark raw SAML logs out-of-scope without DPA amendment.

raj: KMS custody blurb (snippet): "During the POC Redwood-managed keys will be used; keys are stored encrypted, access restricted to HSM-backed services, and keys are not exportable. Customers may opt into BYOK prior to Dedicated production rollout."

ben: I'll push pen-letter draft to Legal now and ask for expedited review. If PledgeBank can confirm vendor name + desired test window today we may get signature before Friday.

evan: Pricing Q: PledgeBank asked if Dedicated POC rate can be pro-rated/refunded if they cancel early. Quick answer: we can offer a 60-day refundable commit as a commercial exception (prorated refund before day 30). I'll confirm the numbers with pricing ops and post a proposal.

marie: Action items: Marie - SOC2 mapping + evidence pointers (EOD tom), Raj - KMS custody note (tom morning), Ben - pen-letter draft -> Legal (today, need vendor + CIDR), Infra - NET-2045 for diagram (36 hrs after Dedicated confirm), Evan - pricing proposal (today). I'll update customer with tentative timelines.

tash: Thanks team. I'll ask PledgeBank for vendor name, desired scan window, and whether they will accept redacted SAML logs. Planning a sync Fri to finalize.
